```{r}
Final_path_ <- "/Users/oo21097/Desktop/MRES_Kimbe_Bay/Microbial_Data/Novogene_Results/00.CleanData/Final_Dada2"
kimbe_phyloseq_rare <- readRDS(file.path(Final_path, "kimbe_phyloseq_rare.rds"))
```

```{r}
library(phyloseq)
library(dplyr)

# total unique ASVs
total_asvs <- ntaxa(kimbe_phyloseq_rare)
total_asvs

```
```{r}
water_phy <- subset_samples(kimbe_phyloseq_rare, SampleType == "W")
sed_phy   <- subset_samples(kimbe_phyloseq_rare, SampleType == "S")

```

```{r}
# presence/absence tables
water_asvs <- taxa_names(prune_taxa(taxa_sums(water_phy) > 0, water_phy))
sed_asvs   <- taxa_names(prune_taxa(taxa_sums(sed_phy) > 0, sed_phy))

# unique counts
unique_water <- setdiff(water_asvs, sed_asvs)
unique_sed   <- setdiff(sed_asvs, water_asvs)
shared_asvs  <- intersect(water_asvs, sed_asvs)

cat("Total ASVs:", total_asvs, "\n")
cat("Water-only ASVs:", length(unique_water), "\n")
cat("Sediment-only ASVs:", length(unique_sed), "\n")
cat("Shared ASVs:", length(shared_asvs), "\n")

```

```{r}
ka_phy <- subset_samples(kimbe_phyloseq_rare, Location == "KA")
kd_phy <- subset_samples(kimbe_phyloseq_rare, Location == "KD")
ke_phy <- subset_samples(kimbe_phyloseq_rare, Location == "KE")
km_phy <- subset_samples(kimbe_phyloseq_rare, Location == "KM")


ka_asvs <- taxa_names(prune_taxa(taxa_sums(ka_phy) > 0, ka_phy))
kd_asvs <- taxa_names(prune_taxa(taxa_sums(kd_phy) > 0, kd_phy))
ke_asvs <- taxa_names(prune_taxa(taxa_sums(ke_phy) > 0, ke_phy))
km_asvs <- taxa_names(prune_taxa(taxa_sums(km_phy) > 0, km_phy))


```

```{r}
shared_all   <- Reduce(intersect, list(ka_asvs, kd_asvs, ke_asvs, km_asvs))
shared_ka_ke <- intersect(ka_asvs, ke_asvs)
shared_ka_kd <- intersect(ka_asvs, kd_asvs)
shared_ka_km <- intersect(ka_asvs, km_asvs)
shared_kd_ke <- intersect(kd_asvs, ke_asvs)
shared_kd_km <- intersect(kd_asvs, km_asvs)
shared_ke_km <- intersect(ke_asvs, km_asvs)



cat("Shared across all sites:", length(shared_all), "\n")
cat("Shared KA–KE:", length(shared_ka_ke), "\n")
cat("Shared KA–KD:", length(shared_ka_kd), "\n")
cat("Shared KA–KM:", length(shared_ka_km), "\n")
cat("Shared KD–KE:", length(shared_kd_ke), "\n")
cat("Shared KD–KM:", length(shared_kd_km), "\n")
cat("Shared KE–KM:", length(shared_ke_km), "\n")


# ---- Step X: Unique ASVs per location ----

unique_ka <- setdiff(ka_asvs, union(kd_asvs, ke_asvs, km_asvs))
unique_kd <- setdiff(kd_asvs, union(ka_asvs, ke_asvs, km_asvs))
unique_ke <- setdiff(ke_asvs, union(ka_asvs, kd_asvs, km_asvs))
unique_km <- setdiff(km_asvs, union(ka_asvs, kd_asvs, ke_asvs))

cat("Unique ASVs in NM only:", length(unique_nm), "\n")
cat("Unique ASVs in NN only:", length(unique_nn), "\n")
cat("Unique ASVs in NV only:", length(unique_nv), "\n\n")

```

```{r}
# Lists of ASVs by site
asv_sets <- list(NM = nm_asvs, NN = nn_asvs, NV = nv_asvs)

# Shared by all three
shared_all <- Reduce(intersect, asv_sets)

# Shared by exactly two (exclude triple-shared)
shared_nm_nn <- setdiff(intersect(nm_asvs, nn_asvs), shared_all)
shared_nm_nv <- setdiff(intersect(nm_asvs, nv_asvs), shared_all)
shared_nn_nv <- setdiff(intersect(nn_asvs, nv_asvs), shared_all)

# Unique to each site (exclude any shared ASVs)
unique_nm <- setdiff(nm_asvs, union(nn_asvs, nv_asvs))
unique_nn <- setdiff(nn_asvs, union(nm_asvs, nv_asvs))
unique_nv <- setdiff(nv_asvs, union(nm_asvs, nn_asvs))

# Combine into summary table
exclusive_summary <- data.frame(
  Category = c("Unique to NM",
               "Unique to NN",
               "Unique to NV",
               "Shared NM–NN only",
               "Shared NM–NV only",
               "Shared NN–NV only",
               "Shared all three"),
  Count = c(length(unique_nm),
            length(unique_nn),
            length(unique_nv),
            length(shared_nm_nn),
            length(shared_nm_nv),
            length(shared_nn_nv),
            length(shared_all))
)

print(exclusive_summary)
```

### EXCLUDING SHARED ASVs BETWEEN WATER AND SEDIMENT ###

```{r}
# Exclude ASVs present in both habitats
water_only_asvs <- setdiff(taxa_names(water_phy), shared_asvs)
sed_only_asvs   <- setdiff(taxa_names(sed_phy), shared_asvs)

# Subset phyloseq objects to only these ASVs
water_phy_unique <- prune_taxa(water_only_asvs, water_phy)
sed_phy_unique   <- prune_taxa(sed_only_asvs, sed_phy)

```

###WATER PER LOCATION###

```{r}
# Subset water samples by location
ka_w_phy <- subset_samples(water_phy_unique, Location == "KA")
kd_w_phy <- subset_samples(water_phy_unique, Location == "KD")
ke_w_phy <- subset_samples(water_phy_unique, Location == "KE")
km_w_phy <- subset_samples(water_phy_unique, Location == "KM")


# Extract ASV names present in each
ka_w_asvs <- taxa_names(prune_taxa(taxa_sums(ka_w_phy) > 0, ka_w_phy))
kd_w_asvs <- taxa_names(prune_taxa(taxa_sums(kd_w_phy) > 0, kd_w_phy))
ke_w_asvs <- taxa_names(prune_taxa(taxa_sums(ke_w_phy) > 0, ke_w_phy))
km_w_asvs <- taxa_names(prune_taxa(taxa_sums(km_w_phy) > 0, km_w_phy))


```

```{r}
# Shared across all three water locations
shared_w_all <- Reduce(intersect, list(ka_w_asvs, kd_w_asvs, ke_w_asvs, km_w_asvs))

# Shared between exactly two locations (exclude ASVs in all three)
shared_w_ka_kd <- setdiff(intersect(ka_w_asvs, kd_w_asvs), shared_w_all)
shared_w_ka_ke <- setdiff(intersect(ka_w_asvs, ke_w_asvs), shared_w_all)
shared_w_ka_km <- setdiff(intersect(ka_w_asvs, km_w_asvs), shared_w_all)
shared_w_kd_ke <- setdiff(intersect(kd_w_asvs, ke_w_asvs), shared_w_all)
shared_w_kd_km <- setdiff(intersect(kd_w_asvs, km_w_asvs), shared_w_all)
shared_w_ke_km <- setdiff(intersect(ke_w_asvs, km_w_asvs), shared_w_all)


# Unique to each water location (not in the other two)
unique_w_ka <- setdiff(ka_w_asvs, union(kd_w_asvs, union(ke_w_asvs, km_w_asvs)))
unique_w_kd <- setdiff(kd_w_asvs, union(ka_w_asvs, union(ke_w_asvs, km_w_asvs)))
unique_w_ke <- setdiff(ke_w_asvs, union(kd_w_asvs, union(ka_w_asvs, km_w_asvs)))
unique_w_km <- setdiff(km_w_asvs, union(kd_w_asvs, union(ke_w_asvs, ka_w_asvs)))
```

```{r}
water_summary <- data.frame(
  Category = c("Unique to KA_W",
               "Unique to KD_W",
               "Unique to KE_W",
               "Unique to KM_W",
               "Shared KA–KD only",
               "Shared KA–KE only",
               "Shared KA–KM only",
               "Shared KD–KE only",
               "Shared KD–KM only",
               "Shared KE–KM only",
               "Shared all four water sites"),
  Count = c(length(unique_w_ka),
            length(unique_w_kd),
            length(unique_w_ke),
            length(unique_w_km),
            length(shared_w_ka_kd),
            length(shared_w_ka_ke),
            length(shared_w_ka_km),
            length(shared_w_kd_ke),
            length(shared_w_kd_km),
            length(shared_w_ke_km),
            length(shared_w_all))
)

o1
```




###SEDIMENT PER LOCATION###

```{r}
# Subset sediment samples by location
ka_s_phy <- subset_samples(sed_phy_unique, Location == "KA")
kd_s_phy <- subset_samples(sed_phy_unique, Location == "KD")
ke_s_phy <- subset_samples(sed_phy_unique, Location == "KE")
km_s_phy <- subset_samples(sed_phy_unique, Location == "KM")


# Extract ASV names present in each
ka_s_asvs <- taxa_names(prune_taxa(taxa_sums(ka_s_phy) > 0, ka_s_phy))
kd_s_asvs <- taxa_names(prune_taxa(taxa_sums(kd_s_phy) > 0, kd_s_phy))
ke_s_asvs <- taxa_names(prune_taxa(taxa_sums(ke_s_phy) > 0, ke_s_phy))
km_s_asvs <- taxa_names(prune_taxa(taxa_sums(km_s_phy) > 0, km_s_phy))
```

```{r}
# Shared across all four sediment locations
shared_s_all <- Reduce(intersect, list(ka_s_asvs, kd_s_asvs, ke_s_asvs, km_s_asvs))

# Shared between exactly two locations (exclude ASVs in all three)
shared_s_ka_kd <- setdiff(intersect(ka_s_asvs, kd_s_asvs), shared_s_all)
shared_s_ka_ke <- setdiff(intersect(ka_s_asvs, ke_s_asvs), shared_s_all)
shared_s_ka_km <- setdiff(intersect(ka_s_asvs, km_s_asvs), shared_s_all)
shared_s_kd_ke <- setdiff(intersect(kd_s_asvs, ke_s_asvs), shared_s_all)
shared_s_kd_km <- setdiff(intersect(kd_s_asvs, km_s_asvs), shared_s_all)
shared_s_ke_km <- setdiff(intersect(ke_s_asvs, km_s_asvs), shared_s_all)


# Unique to each sediment location (not in the other two)
unique_s_ka <- setdiff(ka_s_asvs, union(kd_s_asvs, union(ke_s_asvs, km_s_asvs)))
unique_s_kd <- setdiff(kd_s_asvs, union(ka_s_asvs, union(ke_s_asvs, km_s_asvs)))
unique_s_ke <- setdiff(ke_s_asvs, union(kd_s_asvs, union(ka_s_asvs, km_s_asvs)))
unique_s_km <- setdiff(km_s_asvs, union(kd_s_asvs, union(ke_s_asvs, ka_s_asvs)))

```
